---
title: "Hazelnut dashboard"
title-tr: "Fındık gösterge paneli"
description: "Giresun hazelnut prices, the six-month price range, export destinations, crop size against price, and how the forecasts scored against naive."
description-tr: "Giresun fındık fiyatları, altı aylık fiyat aralığı, ihracat pazarları, hasadın fiyatla ilişkisi ve tahminlerin naif tahmine karşı aldığı puanlar."
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.forecast.dataset import SHOCK_PERIODS
from hazelnut.site import charts, i18n
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.i18n import t
from hazelnut.site.labels import crop_estimate_label
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
data_dir = SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug
local = crop.local_currency
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(data_dir / "manifest.json")

prices = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "prices_monthly.csv",
                             required=("month", "season", "usd_kg", local.column))
price_range = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "price_range.csv",
                                  required=("horizon", "target_month", "q05", "q10", "q50",
                                            "q90", "q95", "from_month", "from_usd"))
exports_top = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "exports_top.csv",
                                  required=("partner", "net_kg", "fob_usd", "share"))
SOURCE = crop.exchanges[0]  # whose crop estimate is plotted
CROP_COL = "giresun_estimate_t"  # the crop size plotted: Giresun exchange's estimate
crop_by_year = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "crop_by_year.csv",
                                   required=("year", "season", CROP_COL, "season_avg_usd"))
scoreboard = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "results" / "scoreboard_dev.csv",
                                 required=("method", "horizon", "n", "ratio"))
holdout = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "results" / "scoreboard_holdout.csv",
                              required=("method", "horizon", "ratio"))
ranges = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "results" / "ranges.csv")

# The shocks the price subtitle names (hazelnut copy); dates come from SHOCK_PERIODS.
SHOCK_NAMES = {y: t(f"{crop.slug}.dashboard.shock.y{y}") for y in ("2014", "2025")}
named_shocks = [(SHOCK_NAMES[a[:4]], (a, b)) for a, b in SHOCK_PERIODS if a[:4] in SHOCK_NAMES]
RANGE_METHOD = "naive_emp"  # price_range.csv is the empirical-naive range (site_data.py)
```

```{python}
stamp = ""
if manifest is not None:
    stamp = (f'<span class="live"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>'
             f'{ph.escape(ph.as_of_stamp(manifest))}</span>')
ph.raw_html(
    '<div class="dash-head"><div>'
    f'<span class="eyebrow">{ph.escape(t("dashboard.eyebrow", crop=i18n.crop_name(crop)))}</span>'
    f'<h1>{ph.escape(t("dashboard.h1"), quote=False)}</h1></div>'
    f"{stamp}</div>"
)
```

::: {.dash}

::: {#panel-price .panel .span-8}
```{python}
ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(
    t(f"{crop.slug}.dashboard.price_title"),
    ph.price_subtitle(prices, named_shocks) if prices is not None
    else t("price.fallback"),
))
if prices is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    charts.show(charts.price_history(prices, SHOCK_PERIODS, local.column, local.label))
    ph.raw_html(
        '<p class="foot">'
        + ph.escape(t("dashboard.price_foot", years=ph.shock_years_label(SHOCK_PERIODS),
                      local=local.label), quote=False)
        + "</p>"
    )
```
:::

::: {#panel-range .panel .span-4}
```{python}
ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(
    t("dashboard.range_title"),
    ph.range_subtitle(price_range) if price_range is not None
    else t("dashboard.range_fallback"),
))
range_label = ph.range_currencies_label(crop.range_currencies)
show_range = price_range is not None and "usd" in crop.range_currencies
if not show_range:
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
```

::: {.range-body}
```{python}
if show_range:
    charts.show(charts.price_range_fig(price_range))
    # Shown instead of the chart while the price chart is on a currency the range was
    # not tested in (the script at the end of the page listens to its USD/TL buttons).
    ph.raw_html(f'<div class="range-note" role="status" data-currencies="{range_label}">'
                f'{ph.escape(t("dashboard.range_note", currencies=range_label), quote=False)}</div>')
```
:::

```{python}
if show_range:
    note = ph.range_coverage_note(ranges, RANGE_METHOD, int(price_range["horizon"].max()))
    if note:
        ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(note)}</p>')
```
:::

::: {#panel-exports .panel .span-4}
```{python}
period = ph.output_month_label(manifest, "exports_top")
ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(
    t("dashboard.exports_title"),
    ph.exports_subtitle(exports_top, period) if exports_top is not None and period
    else t("dashboard.exports_fallback"),
))
if exports_top is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    charts.show(charts.bar_top(exports_top))
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(t("dashboard.exports_foot"), quote=False)}</p>')
```
:::

::: {#panel-crop .panel .span-4}
```{python}
if crop_by_year is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(t("dashboard.crop_title"), t("crop_price.fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    crop_df, crop_sub, crop_note = ph.crop_panel(crop_by_year, CROP_COL, prices)
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(t("dashboard.crop_title"), crop_sub))
    charts.show(charts.crop_vs_price(crop_df, CROP_COL, crop_estimate_label(SOURCE)))
    foot = t("dashboard.crop_foot", source=SOURCE) + (" " + crop_note if crop_note else "")
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(foot, quote=False)}</p>')
```
:::

::: {#panel-scoreboard .panel .span-4}
```{python}
if scoreboard is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(t("dashboard.scoreboard_title"),
                                   t("dashboard.scoreboard_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(t("dashboard.scoreboard_title"),
                                   ph.scoreboard_subtitle(scoreboard)))
    ph.raw_html(ph.scoreboard_html(scoreboard, holdout, "analyses/forecasting.qmd",
                                   methods_href="../methods.qmd"))
```

```{=html}
<script>
/* Panel 2 follows panel 1's currency buttons: when the price chart shows a currency the
   range was not tested in, the range panel shows a note instead of the chart. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var price = document.querySelector("#panel-price [data-plotly]");
  var note = document.querySelector("#panel-range .range-note");
  if (!price || !note) return;
  var body = note.closest(".range-body");
  var tested = (note.getAttribute("data-currencies") || "").split(", ");

  function show(label) {
    if (label) body.classList.toggle("is-untested", tested.indexOf(label) < 0);
  }
  function current() {
    var menu = price.layout && price.layout.updatemenus && price.layout.updatemenus[0];
    var btn = menu && menu.buttons && menu.buttons[menu.active || 0];
    return btn && btn.label;
  }
  function hook() {
    if (typeof price.on !== "function") return false;
    // The period buttons fire this too, so read the currency menu's state (menu 0)
    // rather than the clicked button's label.
    price.on("plotly_buttonclicked", function () { show(current()); });
    price.on("plotly_afterplot", function () { show(current()); });
    show(current());
    return true;
  }
  // site.js draws the chart once plotly.js has loaded; hook in when it becomes a plot.
  if (!hook()) {
    new MutationObserver(function (_, obs) { if (hook()) obs.disconnect(); })
      .observe(price, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
  }
})();
</script>
```
